results.text:
[1:56 pm on 8 May, 2023]
Caroline: Hey Mel! Good to see you! How have you been?
Melanie: Hey Caroline! I'm swamped with the kids & work. What's up with you?
Caroline: I went to a LGBTQ support group yesterday and it was so powerful.
Melanie: Wow, that's cool! Did you hear any inspiring stories?
Caroline: The transgender stories really got to me. I'm thinking about counseling as a career.
Melanie: You'd be great at that. I painted a lake sunrise last year that still makes me happy.
Caroline: I'd love to see it. I'm also taking the kids swimming next weekend.
results.why: A whole session, not a single sentence. The one-line version of this test passed while a real LoCoMo session produced ten memories and not one date — the length and the competing topics are the failure, so the test has to carry them.
